summary: 谓语动词的单复数要与主语在语法、意义或就近原则上一致。三大原则：语法一致、意义一致、就近一致。
signals: a number of + 复数动词
the number of + 单数动词

rules.title: 语法一致：主语单复数决定谓语
rules.detail: 单个主语用单数；and 连接两个主语用复数；each/every/no + 单数名词作主语时谓语用单数。

examples.en: The number of students is increasing.
Every student and every teacher was invited.
examples.zh: 每个学生和每位老师都受到邀请。

rules.title: 意义一致：看含义不看形式
rules.detail: 集体名词（family, team, class, government）表整体用单数，表成员用复数；police, cattle 恒复数；news, physics, maths 形复实单；表示时间、金钱、距离的复数名词作整体看用单数。

examples.en: My family is a big one. / My family are all football fans.
examples.zh: 我家是个大家庭。/ 我家人都是球迷。

examples.en: Ten years is a long time.
The police are searching for the thief.

rules.title: 就近一致与特定结构
rules.detail: either...or / neither...nor / not only...but also / there be 句型遵循就近原则；as well as / together with / along with 前面的主语决定谓语；a number of + 复数（谓语复数），the number of + 复数（谓语单数）。

examples.en: Neither the students nor the teacher knows the answer.
examples.zh: 学生们和老师都不知道答案。

examples.en: The teacher as well as the students likes the film.
examples.zh: 老师和学生都喜欢这部电影。

pitfalls: a number of 与 the number of 混淆：前者「许多」谓语复数，后者「……的数量」谓语单数
as well as 后的名词误作主语核心：谓语跟随前面的主语
each/every 并列结构仍用单数

questions.stem: A number of students ___ interested in computer games.
questions.explain: a number of = 许多，谓语用复数 are。

questions.stem: The number of the workers in this factory ___ about 500.
questions.explain: the number of = ……的数量，谓语用单数 is。

questions.stem: Either you or the headmaster ___ the prizes at the meeting.
questions.explain: either...or 就近原则：靠近谓语的是 the headmaster（单数）。

questions.stem: Physics ___ my favorite subject when I was at school.
questions.explain: physics 形复实单，作一门学科看待；was at school 提示过去时。
but Jane 是介词短语，真正主语是 nobody（单数），谓语 knows。

questions.stem: Not only the students but also the teacher ___ (be) invited to the party.
questions.explain: not only...but also 就近原则：the teacher 单数，用 was。

questions.stem: Mr. Smith as well as his children were invited to the ball.
questions.explain: as well as 连接时谓语跟随前面的主语 Mr. Smith（单数），用 was。

questions.stem: 这个班的每个学生都有一本词典。（翻译整句）
answer: every student in this class has a dictionary.
each student in the class has a dictionary.
questions.explain: every/each + 单数名词作主语，谓语用单数 has。

questions.stem: 骑自行车是一种很好的锻炼方式。（翻译整句）
answer: riding a bike is a good way to exercise.
cycling is a good way to exercise.
questions.explain: 动名词短语作主语谓语用单数 is。
